payout_quote: Earn a $400 Statement Credit. After making at least $3,000 in net purchases during the first three billing cycles following account opening.
steps: Read the official PNC business card page and its rates-and-fees section.
Apply online, by phone, or in a branch for the PNC Cash Rewards Visa Signature Business card; a hard credit inquiry is part of the application.
Make at least $3,000 in net purchases during the first three billing cycles — only business spending you already planned.
Pay the balance in full each month.
Receive the $400 statement credit after meeting the requirement.
catches: Never spend extra solely to earn the bonus — only the $3,000 of business purchases you already planned counts; do not inflate spending.

No annual fee is advertised on PNC's official page for this card, so the $400 should be yours to keep net — but confirm the $0 fee in the cardholder agreement when you apply, since any fee would reduce the payout.
Applying triggers a hard inquiry on your credit report, which can temporarily lower your score.
Carried-balance interest erases the bonus: after the 0% intro APR (9 billing cycles), the variable APR is 17.49%-27.74% — always pay in full.

Business-only: you need a business to qualify; PNC warns that if your assigned credit limit is under $3,000 you may struggle to meet the spend requirement, and the account must stay in good standing or you forfeit the bonus.
biggest_catch: Business-only and the $3,000 bar is real: you need a business, and if PNC assigns you a credit limit under $3,000 you may not be able to hit the requirement at all — plus the account must stay in good standing or the bonus is forfeited.
eligibility: Businesses; new accounts only (not existing PNC Cash Rewards business accounts); $3,000 in net purchases in the first 3 billing cycles; account must remain in good standing.
timing: Statement credit awarded within 90 days of meeting the $3,000 requirement.
